title: Multi-period YIELD starts from a schedule-free par-100 seed, steps analytic Newton on 1+y/f, and publishes pre-step y when |step| <= 1e-10
statement: Superseding the near-par special case in FN-YIELD-001, Excel 16.0.20527 runs one universal solver for all multi-period YIELD calls (n > 1), regardless of coupon date or redemption. It first computes a schedule-free years-to-maturity T (using US/European 30/360 / 360 for bases 0 and 4, and k + (m - s_k) / year_days for bases 1..3 where s_k uses DATE(sy + k, sm, sd) day rollover), forms d = price - 100.0 (hardcoded 100.0, never redemption), and sets the initial iterate y_0 = f * ((tau * rate * 100 / f - d) / ((tau * 100 + d * tau / 2) + d * f / 4)). Each Newton step evaluates base = 1.0 + y / f (whose rounding into [1, 2) produces +109-ULP sawtooth jumps as y crosses base binade boundaries), sums coupon and redemption terms using excel_bond_pow, and checks |step| <= 1e-10 (0x3ddb7cdfd9d7bdbb): when satisfied, Excel returns the un-updated iterate y before subtracting step (leaving up to 2,844 ULP differences when |step_0| <= 1e-10). After 100 iterations without stopping, Excel returns y_100.
basis: Measured across 3,198 cb4 live Excel 16.0.20527 calls and two prospective frozen holdout suites (frozen_yield_cb4.jsonl 413 of 500, and frozen_yield_v2_cb4.jsonl 244 of 250 including 100 of 100 on bases 1 and 3 with s_k rollover). Landing nx3 moved the YIELD full witness bank from 3,053 to 3,489 of 3,489 (+436, worst ULP 2,844 -> 0) and the pinned bank from 21 to 120 of 120 (+99).
inferred: The exact Newton loop form and 100-iteration fallback are inferred from matching all 3,489 full-bank rows, 120 pinned rows, and 64 of 64 consecutive-price sawtooth sweeps.
